intentAlignment.reason: 实现严格 pending parity registry，且仅允许身份、PR、Git 拓扑与生命周期全部精确绑定的 current archived Work Item 临时延迟三语 parity；未复制或改写 WI-242 历史记录。

recoveryCondition: Repair the Contract or governance projection, rerun preflight, and retry finish.

scenarioCoverage.expected: An exact pending entry suppresses only the three missing parity findings while all ordinary archive, evidence, finalization, repository, PR, base, head, and path bindings remain valid.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Build a feature-branch fixture whose registry append is the only change after the bound head and assert lifecycleState=pending_parity_registration with no blocking findings.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Unknown fields, duplicate identities, symlinks, unsafe paths, missing fields or records, foreign identities, and PR/base/head/path mismatches fail closed with deterministic findings.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run focused registry fixtures for every malformed, foreign, duplicate, missing, symlink, and mismatch class and assert exact nonzero findings.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A pending entry on the default branch, after merge observation, or alongside any parity row is stale and cannot suppress normal parity requirements.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run main/merged and parity-present fixtures and assert stale_pending_parity_registration.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The manifest and typed route execute the pending registry regression for light, standard, and strict profiles without command overrides.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run repository manifest and quality route regressions, then consume a strict typed route receipt through the canonical runner.

scenarioCoverage.expected: English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese docs state that pending is identity-bound, non-terminal, and must be promoted to normal parity with registry removal after merge.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run documentation acceptance and parity governance checks over the synchronized three-language docs.
